text:
Samira K.: quick flag — we have a coverage hole for the late-night window this weekend (Sat 03:00-11:00 UTC). primary for that shift hasn’t been claimed. i’m out of hours and can’t take it. anyone available to pick up or swap?

Jorge L.: might be able to take the primary if we confirm handoff details. is there any active customer impact or pagers for that window?

Incident Bot: rotation summary — upcoming shifts: Fri 19:00-03:00 UTC (Primary: Ivy Z., Secondary: Jorge L.); Sat 03:00-11:00 UTC (Primary: UNASSIGNED, Secondary: UNASSIGNED); Sat 11:00-19:00 UTC (Primary: Marcus T.).

Ivy Z.: no active incidents currently. last week we had a brief spike on /v1/generate at 04:12 UTC but it was auto-failed-over. still, that window is when APAC traffic tends to ramp. would prefer someone with experience on the model routing fallback runbook.

Samira K.: thanks ivy — routing fallback runbook is under /runbooks/inference/fallback-routing. key points: 1) check upstream capacity in region, 2) enable model-variant fallback via console, 3) temporarily raise batch size limit if latency allows. also review the customer-impact checklist in the runbook before acknowledging any pager.

Jorge L.: ok. i can take primary but i’ll be traveling and only have phone + laptop. prefer a secondary who can be ready to escalate. @Ivy Z. can you be secondary for the first two hours in case we need a hands-on console user?

Ivy Z.: yep i can cover secondary from 03:00-05:00 UTC. if it looks stable after that i’ll hand back.

Samira K.: sweet, can one of you run a rotationbot swap so the schedule shows assigned? also add a short note in the handoff doc about potential APAC latency spike.

RotationBot: to swap shifts run: `@rotationbot swap --from <current> --to <new> --when <start_iso>`

Jorge L.: running it now: 

```
@rotationbot swap --from UNASSIGNED --to Jorge L. --when 2026-04-03T03:00Z
``` 
(please confirm)

RotationBot: swap request queued. please confirm by reacting :white_check_mark: within 10 minutes.

Samira K.: reacted :white_check_mark:. also quick note — escalation matrix: primary handles paging and postmortem notes, secondary is on-call support and will take over if primary is unreachable for >10 minutes. if customer impact exceeds P1 threshold, follow the incident template and add a triage label.

Ivy Z.: added a short handoff blurb: "APAC traffic spike possibility around 04:00 UTC; watch token-per-second and model-fallbacks; contact infra on-call if host-level OOMs show up." linked the runbook and the console dashboard.

Jorge L.: ack. i’ll set phone to Do Not Disturb exceptions only for incident bot pings. can you paste the quick commands for checking KV cache stats? want to be ready.

Ivy Z.: quick checks: 

```
# list kv cache sizes by model
redwoodctl cache list --model gpt-redwood-3b
# check cache hit rate
redwoodctl metrics get --name kv_cache_hit_ratio --window 5m
``` 
if hit rate is dropping below 60% within a cluster, consider forcing a prefix cache refresh per runbook.

Jorge L.: perfect. i’ll put a short note in the rota and in the thread so whoever follows knows the context. thanks team.

Samira K.: done — rota updated, runbook link in handoff doc, and incident bot will post a reminder 1 hour before shift start. everyone please ack in the thread when set.

Jorge L.: ack.

Ivy Z.: ack.

Incident Bot: reminder scheduled — 1 hour before 2026-04-03T03:00Z.

Samira K.: closing this thread. if anything changes ping @eng-oncall and update the rota. good catch, team :)
